description: Geluidsbelastingskaart Spoor (Lden) Gent (2021) is a dataset listed in Open Data Portaal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Open Data Portaal. Strategische geluidsbelastingskaart voor de stad Gent betreffende spoorverkeer volgens RL 2002/49/EG. Het referentiejaar van deze data is 2021. Op de geluidskaart wordt aangegeven aan hoeveel geluid de omgeving wordt blootgesteld. De geluidsbelasting wordt daarbij uitgedrukt in de parameter Lden. Coverage: Ghent. The portal files it under Natuur & milieu. The portal shows 1,567 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-02-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-stad-gent-portal.
